svg.title: Same starting state, separate futures
svg.desc: A parent run pauses at a tick where every camera is due. The complete CPU state is checkpointed. Before a sibling branch is admitted, the saved transitions are replayed, the canonical CPU state is compared, a fresh static renderer starts and camera pixels are checked by digest. Restoring the engine's own snapshot failed full-state equality in larger cases, so replay is used. Equal pixels do not prove equal hidden graphics state.
